rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey... I heard the Iiran capital was
attacked. Were the residents safe?

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0002
rows.name:
You thought I'd be more gung-ho
about it, did you? Thought I'd
want a piece of the action?

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0003
rows.name:
No, even I got chills when I heard
about that Heaven-whatever thing.

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I hear he's burned cities to the
ground without a trace. Urgh...

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0005
rows.name:
But I heard you protected the city and
its people from that thing.

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0006
rows.name:
I have to say, I'm pretty jealous
of your strength and bravery...

rows.label: tlk70000120_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Well, I won't be beaten! I'll
just have to train even harder!
